description: Byte vectors hand-encoded from the Bluetooth SIG layouts; each characteristic or encoder family names its exact source document, section and table under provenance. Synthetic: they share one reading of the specification with the codec, so a real KICKR CORE capture recorded on the diagnostics page is committed next to this file as kickr-core-<firmware>.json and decoded too.

decode.indoorBikeData: Bluetooth SIG Fitness Machine Service 1.0 (FTMS_v1.0) section 4.9 Indoor Bike Data, Table 4.10 (flag bits and field presence); field types, units and resolutions from GATT Specification Supplement YAML, bitbucket.org/bluetooth-SIG/public gss/ (revision of 2026-02-05), org.bluetooth.characteristic.indoor_bike_data. Resistance Level is sint16 in the characteristic definition published with FTMS 1.0 and uint8 in the current GSS; both layouts have a vector.
decode.cyclingPowerMeasurement: GATT Specification Supplement YAML, bitbucket.org/bluetooth-SIG/public gss/ (revision of 2026-02-05), org.bluetooth.characteristic.cycling_power_measurement: structure table, Flags field, Wheel Revolution Data and Crank Revolution Data field tables. Bluetooth SIG Cycling Power Service 1.1.
decode.cyclingPowerFeature: GATT Specification Supplement YAML, bitbucket.org/bluetooth-SIG/public gss/ (revision of 2026-02-05), org.bluetooth.characteristic.cycling_power_feature: Cycling Power Feature bit table (bit 2 wheel, bit 3 crank revolution data).
decode.heartRateMeasurement: GATT Specification Supplement YAML, bitbucket.org/bluetooth-SIG/public gss/ (revision of 2026-02-05), org.bluetooth.characteristic.heart_rate_measurement: structure table, Flags field and RR-Interval field. Bluetooth SIG Heart Rate Service 1.0.
decode.fitnessMachineFeature: Bluetooth SIG Fitness Machine Service 1.0 (FTMS_v1.0) section 4.3: Table 4.2 (structure), Table 4.3 (Fitness Machine Features bits), Table 4.4 (Target Setting Features bits).
decode.supportedPowerRange: Bluetooth SIG Fitness Machine Service 1.0 (FTMS_v1.0) section 4.14; GATT Specification Supplement YAML, bitbucket.org/bluetooth-SIG/public gss/ (revision of 2026-02-05), org.bluetooth.characteristic.supported_power_range.
decode.controlPointResponse: Bluetooth SIG Fitness Machine Service 1.0 (FTMS_v1.0) section 4.16.2.22: Table 4.23 (response indication format) and Table 4.24 (result codes).
decode.fitnessMachineStatus: Bluetooth SIG Fitness Machine Service 1.0 (FTMS_v1.0) section 4.17: Table 4.26 (status op codes and parameters), Table 4.16 (control information), Table 4.27 (spin down status).

encode.requestControl: Bluetooth SIG Fitness Machine Service 1.0 (FTMS_v1.0) section 4.16.1, Table 4.15, op code 0x00.
encode.reset: Bluetooth SIG Fitness Machine Service 1.0 (FTMS_v1.0) section 4.16.1, Table 4.15, op code 0x01.
encode.startOrResume: Bluetooth SIG Fitness Machine Service 1.0 (FTMS_v1.0) section 4.16.1, Table 4.15, op code 0x07.
encode.stopOrPause: Bluetooth SIG Fitness Machine Service 1.0 (FTMS_v1.0) section 4.16.1, Table 4.15, op code 0x08; parameter values from section 4.16.2.9, Table 4.16.
encode.setTargetPower: Bluetooth SIG Fitness Machine Service 1.0 (FTMS_v1.0) section 4.16.1, Table 4.15, op code 0x05 with a SINT16 watts parameter at 1 W resolution.
encode.setIndoorBikeSimulation: Bluetooth SIG Fitness Machine Service 1.0 (FTMS_v1.0) section 4.16.1, Table 4.15, op code 0x11; parameter layout from section 4.16.2.18, Table 4.20.
encode.wahooUnlock: Not a SIG specification. Wahoo proprietary trainer characteristic a026e005-0a7d-4ab3-97fa-f1500f9feb8b as used by GoldenCheetah (src/Train/BT40Device.cpp) and qdomyos-zwift (src/devices/wahookickrsnapbike): op code 0x20, payload EE FC. Unverified on hardware.
encode.wahooSetErg: Not a SIG specification. Same sources as wahooUnlock: op code 0x42 with a uint16 little-endian watts target. Unverified on hardware.
